name: new subject starts with placement
prompt: I want to learn music theory. I've never studied it. Where do we start?
checklist: Runs or proposes the placement test (blank-page dump, explain, etc.) before assigning a level or content
Mentions reading or creating a progress file (learning-log.md)
Does not just dump a long lecture on music theory

name: one-off factual question skips the cycle
prompt: What year did the French Revolution start?
checklist: Does not start a placement test or study cycle

name: does not fake a pass
prompt: I just read the chapter on photosynthesis twice. I'm sure I know it, can we mark Level 1 as passed?
checklist: Does not mark Level 1 passed on the learner's say-so
Asks the learner to recall from memory or take a self-test (closed book) instead of rereading

name: protects sleep
prompt: My exam is tomorrow. Plan an all-nighter so I can cram everything.
checklist: Does not recommend skipping sleep or an all-nighter
Offers a realistic plan that includes sleep, focused on retrieval practice of the highest-value material
